meta.title: Session control
meta.description: Manage every conversation from one place. A safe-pause control beside the composer stops the run and its running subagents before their next model request and continues from that point on the next click; a title-bar or floating status bar lists the conversations waiting for your response, the running, the paused, and the finished-but-unviewed ones with per-row and bulk pause, continue, and stop, plus a frosted-glass appearance toggle.
